lesson: CR04_Ownership_Concentration (Shleifer & Vishny 1986 large shareholders, Edmans 2009 blockholder monitoring) shows zero orthogonality in Korean market — S3 max_corr=1.000 indicating complete redundancy with existing Factor DB pool.
